answer: Each submission hangs on the gale of a task receipt, and the meadow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the echo of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
